query:
UPDATE accounts
            SET
                access_token = $3,
                refresh_token = COALESCE($4, refresh_token),
                id_token = COALESCE($5, id_token),
                scope = COALESCE($6, scope),
                access_token_expires_at = $7,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE provider_id = $1 AND account_id = $2
